recommended_additional_public_regression.runtime: Intended to take tens of seconds; duration is unmeasured and depends on the installed environment.
recommended_additional_public_regression.reason: Actual SDK wire tests use MockTransport plus socket/DNS denial; evaluator tests use explicit synthetic observations; selected writer/ref-validation nodes use local synthetic fixtures. No real model, private history or native RAG store is needed.

coverage_limits: Static resolution covers simple Path/constant/global joins; function-generated paths, imported resource maps, strings encoded inside envelopes and arbitrary loaders are not a complete dependency closure.
The 19 docs resources are a static lower bound. The preserved predecessor source_db and sealed receipt preserved_path dependencies are dynamic and intentionally not dereferenced here.
Fixture references can identify mixed modules. Select nodes after source inspection rather than assuming a whole module is archive-dependent or self-contained.

Local model paths in test_post_step7_deepseek_output_binding.py are controlled routing configuration constants; the module uses mocked provider transport and network denial, so they are not classified as real local-weight requirements.
Synthetic schema values such as source_uri=data/raw/... and tmp_path-generated catalog paths are not by themselves evidence of a dependency on real private data.

publication_privacy_adjustments.required_inputs: Original authorized local values only. Do not publish the environment values, private config or historical filename.
publication_privacy_adjustments.scope: Isolated publication copy; production logic and original working-tree test bytes are preserved.
publication_privacy_adjustments.missing_inputs: Explicit SKIPPED or missing-file failure, never historical PASS.
